title: Task difficulty evaluation suite
description: Gold-labelled fixture set for the task-difficulty/v1 contract: the four difficulty labels with boundary minimal pairs, paraphrase clusters, irrelevant-noise cases, embedded prompt-injection payloads whose gradeable task keeps its difficulty, over-500-char truncation cases, multi-turn cases (the router always sees the first user message), and nonstandard styles. The state shape mirrors production exactly: redacted first user message truncated to 500 chars plus message count, rendered as task=<text>; turn=<n>. Labels are agent-drafted pending owner review (label_status in difficulty_cases.json); the builder build_cases.py regenerates the JSON and the review table from reviewable literals, and build_fitting.py maintains the laya-studio fitting corpus (fitting/), which must stay disjoint from the eval set. Replay runs via minder-op difficulty replay, never the sandbox runner. laya-studio fits only on fitting/, never on the eval set.

tasks.title: The task-difficulty/v1 rubric is closed and versioned; changing the rubric text means a new contract version
Deterministic replay of the 200 difficulty cases against a provider through resolve_difficulty; report metrics in the 8C report schema
